Research trajectories
for frontier AI.

We partner with university research labs to capture how research actually happens: forming hypotheses, designing experiments, navigating failures, and deciding what to pursue next.

Beyond code and results, we focus on the intuition, reasoning, communication, and judgment that shape the scientific process.

We turn these trajectories into challenging training and evaluation tasks, helping frontier models develop the scientific reasoning needed to navigate complex, open-ended problems.
